g.text: What do matching indexes change in SQLite?
100,000 tasks; identical queries and outputs; five warmups and 25 operations per attempt. Controlled diagnostic; no SDK or replication
timing. Host: Apple M4. Network: none; in-memory SQLite.

g.text: Dots: independent trial values. Diamond: median. Line: observed min–max, not a confidence interval.
Operation percentiles summarize each trial. Failed latest attempts supply no timing estimate.
Profiles and configured order are preserved; full evidence and source bindings accompany the chart.
